job_description.value:
LaunchPoint Electric Propulsion Solutions, Inc. is an aerospace power generation and electric propulsion design company that is committed to hiring the very best people to join our team. We are passionately focused on designing and manufacturing the best motor and controller solutions for aerospace, thermal management, power generation, and defense. We specialize in gensets, motors and controllers to enable efficient, power dense, reliable, lightweight hybrid-electric and full-electric propulsion solutions.

Come join us in a rare opportunity to get in on the ground floor of a product destined to impact aerospace and advanced air mobility.

Mechanical Engineer III
LaunchPoint EPS is seeking a multidisciplined and self-motivated Mechanical Engineer III to join our team in Goleta, CA. The ME III will assist in product development as well as R&D projects.

The successful candidate will support a cross-functional team that may include Systems Engineers, other Mechanical Engineers, Electrical Engineers, Manufacturing Engineers, Quality Engineers, Machinists and Assembly Technicians. The selected candidate will need to be an individual contributor expected to come up with innovative design solutions to electro-mechanical structures design, electric machine design, electrical packaging, harnessing and thermal and structural issues while adhering to aerospace and MIL environmental constraints. They may also assist in transitioning programs to production, performing tasks such as troubleshooting build issues, working with suppliers, developing production tooling, and developing work instructions.

What You’ll Do
Primary responsibility is to provide mechanical engineering design leadership for company projects
First principles, physics-based / analytical thinker able to propose / solve solutions of varied scope and complexity
Demonstrate strong technical aptitude, excellent communication, and creativity in mechanical design and engineering analysis
Design, develop, modify, and evaluate rugged electric machines and controllers for use in aerospace applications
Determine design approaches, present assessment of alternatives, assumptions, constraints and parameters which leads to a recommendation
Create 3D CAD models of components and assemblies
Performs dimensional tolerance stackup of assemblies to ensure parts compatibility and total design accuracy
Perform structural (Ansys Mechanical) and thermal (Ansys Icepak) analysis using FEA and other tools
Create and/or review detailed engineering drawing packages for fabrication or assyembly
Support prototype and first article New Product Introduction (NPI) builds
Prepare and present technical documentation to program teams and customers
Coordinate with suppliers, develop supply chain and ensure product/component performance to specifications
Mentor more junior engineers in a professional and collaborative way
All other duties as assigned by the VP of Programs and Engineering
Occasional travel may be required
